title: 第五章 秦可卿
content_zh:
清晨，贾珩起了个大早儿，洗漱而罢，简单用些早饭，自里间换了「昌皓」衣坊精制的衣物，这衣服拢共也就两套，基本算是贾珩唯一能拿出来的体面衣服了。
站在铜镜之前，看着身姿挺拔丶眉宇英气的少年，贾珩叹了一口气，这相貌五官，基本就是他前世的古装扮相。
「世上绝无两片一模一样的树叶，自无两个完全一样的人，贾珩，苏珩，谁又能分的清楚呢？」
「珩哥儿，该去秦家了。」就在这时，蔡氏笑语着上前，打断了贾珩的思绪。
贾珩点了点头，整容敛色。
在蔡氏的叮嘱下，贾珩装好婚书，在蔡氏丈夫李大柱的赶车下，向着大功坊而去。
马车之上，倒也备着一些简单的礼物。
秦家在大功坊花枝巷的靠街位置，青墙碧甍，窄窄的一个二重进小院，门前自无荣国府门前威武雄奇的石狮子，只是一个朴素的门楼。
秦业虽为营膳司郎中，但神京居丶大不易，纵然是这般一个小小宅院，都耗费了秦业的半生积蓄。
「吁……」李大柱一拉缰绳，唤停了驴车，回头道：「珩哥儿，到了。」
「多谢李叔。」贾珩道了一声谢。
李大柱是蔡氏之夫，属于典型的庄家汉子，为人木讷丶朴实，平时也是不苟言笑。
李大柱「嗯」了一声，就去栓驴车。
贾珩就上前去扣动门环，整容敛色，想好说辞。
「来了，来了。」
就听得秦家宅院中传来一个女子的声音，伴随着一阵急促丶密集的脚步声，黑油漆的门
「这位公子，这是……」中年妇人打量了一眼贾珩。
贾珩拱了拱手，说道：「婶子，在下贾珩，有一事来拜见秦伯父。」
「贾珩？」那中年妇人想了下，道：「可是荣宁街后廊的柳条胡同的贾大郎？」
贾珩嘴角抽了抽，暗道，贾大郎？他又不是武大郎……

中年妇人笑道：「这两日，老爷还提起你呢，这边，院里请。」
说着，就要邀请贾珩进得院中。
忽地看到李大柱，手中还提着礼物，就道：「这来就来吧，还怎麽好这般破费？」
贾珩从身后的李大柱手中接过礼品，笑了笑，清声道：「初登贵府，不好空手而来，区区薄礼，聊表寸心，不成敬意。」
中年妇人脸上笑意热切了了许多，道：「大郎太客气了。」
贾珩也不好纠正其称呼，只得忍着那一抹心头异样，提着礼物，入得院中。
将贾珩一行几人迎入花厅，那中年妇人就吩咐丫鬟奉上茶点。
从方才路上闲谈得知，贾珩也知，这中年妇人倒并非秦业的侍妾，而是在府中的管事嬷嬷。
那中年妇人才笑道：「老爷今天休沐，原本在家待着的，但早上说要去陶然居会客，我去让人唤一下老爷？」
贾珩面色顿了下，笑了笑道：「有劳。」
中年妇人就从廊檐下唤过来一个小厮，叮嘱两句，返身笑着说道：「贾大郎，多问一句，寻我家老爷是有什麽事儿？」
贾珩沉吟道：「也没什麽急事，只是此事，需得当着秦伯父的面才好说。」
中年妇人笑意吟吟，道：「纵贾大郎不说，老身也能猜着一二。」
「哦？」贾珩放下手中的茶盏，目中有着几分「讶异」。
中年妇人笑了笑，说道：「老爷也说过了，说我家小姐已和贾家大郎定亲，想来就是这位贾公子了。」
想起昨夜秦业唉声叹气的模样，中年妇人心头闪过一念。
后院之中——
「姑娘，贾四家的那珩大爷来了。」一个丫鬟小跑进屋中，面带惊喜说道。
绣房之内，一个正当妙龄，体态婀娜，朱颜粉面的女子，娴静而坐在一面青铜之镜前，在丫鬟的侍奉下，贴着花钿。
铜镜之中，女子花容月貌，云堆翠髻，眉不描而翠，唇不点而红，清丽无端的脸颊上，白璧无瑕，梨腮胜雪。

「人在哪儿呢？」随着一阵酥软丶娇媚的声音响起，秦可卿将螓首转将过来，看向丫鬟宝珠，一双熠熠闪烁的妙目之中，闪烁着好奇之色，依稀可见一缕动人的风情。
她听父亲说，她和贾家柳条胡同的珩大爷订了一门娃娃亲，对这位珩大爷，心中也是好奇的紧。
少女情怀总是诗，秦可卿年岁也不过二八，闺阁之中也难免会对未来的夫君产生一些梦中的期望。
「姑娘，就在花厅和嬷嬷说话呢。」宝珠笑着说道。
秦可卿眉眼低垂，脸颊浮上一抹淡淡的胭脂，道：「我去看看。」
瑞珠连忙起身，拉过秦可卿的藕臂，面有难色说道：「哎呦呦，我的好姑娘，这如何使得，这要是让老爷知道了……」
「好妹妹，我站在帘子后远远看一眼就是。」秦可卿嫣然一笑，轻声说道。
瑞珠见此，道：「那我和姑娘一起去。」
秦业虽为营膳司郎中这样的小官，平日虽疏于对家中一双子女的管教，但在男女大防的问题上，还是对内宅的丫鬟有着叮嘱的。
秦可卿点了点头，带着丫鬟向着前院行去。
贾珩这时与中年妇人吴嬷嬷叙着话，不知不觉就有一盏茶的功夫，但仍不见秦业返回，心头生出一股疑惑同时，考虑是不是起身告辞。
忽地，心头所感，就觉得有人于暗中窥伺。
这是一种前世习武对目光注视的敏锐直觉，心头这般想着，端起茶盏，道：「吴婶，听说贵府有一位秦锺小郎君，怎麽未见？」
吴嬷嬷笑道：「锺儿去上学了，怎麽，珩大爷也听过我家锺二爷的名字？」
贾珩趁势偏转到过头，抬眸看向吴嬷嬷身后的帘子，正好对上一双多情妩媚的眸子，然而四目相碰，那双柔媚如水的眸子，宛若受惊的小鹿一般，收回目光，帘子轻晃。
贾珩沉吟了下，笑了笑，说道：「听街坊说，秦锺兄弟，一表人才，天资聪颖，小小年纪已有清逸超凡之姿。」
这自是恭维之语，吴嬷嬷自不会当真，因此笑道：「珩大爷过誉了。」
吴嬷嬷是秦锺和秦可卿的乳母，受贾珩之夸赞，自是与有荣焉。
帘后，秦可卿走至回廊之中，眼前还回想到那一双沉静丶幽邃的眸子。
有道是，眼睛是心灵之窗，方才虽仅仅是对视一瞬，但不知为何，却像是印在眼前一般。

「姑娘，这位珩大爷……」宝珠低声问道。
秦可卿点了点头，眉眼低垂，脸颊不知何时，已现滚烫，说道：「看着……还行。」
这时代，婚姻大事，遵循父母之命，媒妁之言，秦可卿原本担心碰到一粗鲁丶蠢笨的男子，辱没了她。
但见那少年相貌堂堂，如芝兰玉树，气度沉凝，心头一抹担忧渐去。

content_en:
In the early morning, Jia Heng got up early, washed up, had some breakfast, and changed into clothes made by "Chang Hao" clothing store. There were only two sets of clothes in total, which were basically the only decent clothes Jia Heng could afford.
Standing in front of the bronze mirror, Jia Heng sighed as he looked at the young man with an upright posture and heroic eyebrows. This appearance and facial features were basically his appearance in ancient costume in his previous life.
"There are no two identical leaves in the world, and there are no two identical people, Jia Heng and Su Heng. Who can tell them apart clearly?"
"Brother Heng, it's time to go to Qin's house." At this moment, Cai stepped forward with a smile, interrupting Jia Heng's thoughts.
Jia Heng nodded and put on a facelift.
At Cai's instruction, Jia Heng packed up the marriage certificate and drove toward Dakongfang, driven by Cai's husband Li Dazhu.
There were some simple gifts on the carriage.
The Qin family is located on the street of Huazhi Lane in Dakongfang, with green walls and a narrow courtyard. There is no majestic stone lion in front of the Rongguo Mansion, just a simple gatehouse.
Although Qin Ye is a doctor in the catering department, it is not easy to live in Shenjing. Even such a small house consumes half of Qin Ye's life savings.
"Huh..." Li Dazhu pulled the reins, stopped the donkey cart, and turned around and said, "Brother Heng, we're here."
"Thank you, Uncle Li." Jia Heng thanked him.
Li Dazhu is the husband of the Cai family. He is a typical banker man. He is dull and simple, and he is usually unsmiling.
Li Dazhu said "Yeah" and went to tie the donkey cart.
Jia Heng stepped forward to push the knocker on the door, put on a facelift, calmed down his appearance, and thought of words.
"Coming, coming."
I heard a woman's voice coming from the Qin family's residence, followed by a burst of rapid and dense footsteps, and the black-painted door
"Master, this is..." The middle-aged woman looked at Jia Heng.
Jia Heng cupped his hands and said, "Aunt, Jia Heng, I have something to come to see Uncle Qin."
"Jia Heng?" The middle-aged woman thought for a moment and said, "But Jia Dalang from the Willow Alley on the back porch of Rongning Street?"
The corners of Jia Heng's mouth twitched and he secretly said, Jia Dalang? He is not Wu Dalang...
The middle-aged woman smiled and said: "In the past two days, the master has mentioned you. Here, please come to the courtyard."
With that said, he was about to invite Jia Heng into the courtyard.
Suddenly he saw Li Dazhu, still holding a gift in his hand, and said: "Come here, how can you spend so much money?"
Jia Heng took the gift from Li Dazhu behind him, smiled, and said in a clear voice: "It's my first time to come to your house. It's not good to come empty-handed. It's just a small gift, and it shows your insincerity, which is not respectful."
The smile on the middle-aged woman's face became much warmer and she said, "You are so kind, Mr. Da Lang."
Jia Heng couldn't correct his title, so he had to endure the strange feeling in his heart, carry the gift, and enter the courtyard.
After welcoming Jia Heng and others into the flower hall, the middle-aged woman ordered the maid to serve tea.
From the chat on the road just now, Jia Heng also knew that this middle-aged woman was not Qin Ye's concubine, but the steward of the mansion.
The middle-aged woman smiled and said, "Master is taking a rest today. He was originally staying at home, but in the morning he said he was going to Taoranju to meet guests. Can I ask someone to call Master?"
Jia Heng's expression paused, and he smiled and said, "Thank you."
The middle-aged woman called a boy over from under the eaves, gave a few words of warning, turned around and said with a smile: "Jia Dalang, I want to ask more, what are you looking for for my master?"
Jia Heng said thoughtfully: "There is nothing urgent, but this matter needs to be discussed in front of Uncle Qin."
The middle-aged woman smiled and said, "Even if Jia Dalang doesn't tell me, I can guess a thing or two."
"Oh?" Jia Heng put down the tea cup in his hand, with a bit of "surprise" in his eyes.
The middle-aged woman smiled and said, "The master also said that my young lady has been engaged to the Jia family's eldest son. I think it is this Mr. Jia."
Thinking of Qin Ye sighing last night, the middle-aged womanA thought flashed through my mind.
In the backyard——
"Girl, Uncle Heng from Jia Si's family is here." A maid ran into the house and said with surprise.
In the embroidery room, a young woman with a graceful figure and a pink face sat quietly in front of a bronze mirror, being served by a maid and holding a flower.
In the bronze mirror, there is a woman with a flowery face and a moon-like appearance, with green buns piled among clouds. Her eyebrows are green without being traced, and her lips are red without any spots. On her innocent and beautiful cheeks, she has a flawless white jade, and her pear cheeks are as beautiful as snow.
"Where is he?" As a soft and charming voice sounded, Qin Keqing turned her head around and looked at Maid Baozhu. There was curiosity in her twinkling eyes, and a hint of touching charm could be vaguely seen.
She heard from her father that she had a baby wedding with Uncle Heng from Liutiao Hutong in Jia's house, and she was very curious about this Uncle Heng.
Girls' feelings are always poetic. Qin Keqing is only twenty-eight years old, so it is inevitable that she will have some dream expectations for her future husband in her boudoir.
"Girl, I'm talking to grandma in the flower hall." Baozhu said with a smile.
Qin Keqing's eyebrows were lowered, a touch of rouge appeared on her cheeks, and she said, "I'll go take a look."
Ruizhu stood up quickly, took Qin Keqing's arm, and said with a troubled face: "Oh, my good girl, how can this happen? If the master knows about this..."
"Good sister, I'll just stand behind the curtain and take a look from a distance." Qin Keqing smiled sweetly and said softly.
Seeing this, Ruizhu said, "Then I will go with the girl."
Although Qin Ye was a low-level official like the doctor of the camp and catering department, and although he usually neglected to discipline his two children at home, he still had instructions for the maids in the inner house on the issue of male and female defense.
Qin Keqing nodded and led the maid towards the front yard.
Jia Heng was chatting with the middle-aged woman, Nanny Wu, and had a cup of tea before he knew it. However, Qin Ye still didn't come back. He had doubts in his heart and at the same time, he considered whether to get up and leave.
Suddenly, I felt like someone was watching in the dark.
This is a kind of keen intuition about the gaze of the martial arts practitioner in the previous life. With this thought in his mind, he picked up the tea cup and said: "Aunt Wu, I heard that there is a Mr. Qin Zhong in your mansion, why haven't I seen him?"
Aunt Wu smiled and said, "Zhong'er has gone to school. Why, Uncle Heng has also heard of my second master Zhong's name?"
Jia Heng took advantage of the situation and turned his head, raised his eyes to look at the curtain behind Grandma Wu, and met a pair of passionate and charming eyes. However, when their eyes met, those soft and charming eyes were like a frightened deer. He looked away and the curtain swayed slightly.
Jia Heng pondered for a moment, smiled, and said, "I heard from the neighbors that Brother Qin Zhong is a talented person, very talented, and already has a graceful and extraordinary appearance at a young age."
This was a compliment, and Aunt Wu would not take it seriously, so she smiled and said, "Uncle Heng is overly complimentary."
Aunt Wu was Qin Zhong and Qin Keqing's wet nurse. She was honored by Jia Heng's praise.
Behind the curtain, Qin Keqing walked into the corridor, recalling those quiet and profound eyes before her eyes.
As the saying goes, eyes are the windows to the soul. Even though we just looked at each other for a moment, for some reason, it seemed as if they were imprinted in front of our eyes.
"Girl, this is Uncle Heng..." Bao Zhu asked in a low voice.
Qin Keqing nodded, his eyebrows lowered, his cheeks turned hot before he knew it, and he said, "Look...it's okay."
In this era, marriage was a major matter, following the orders of parents and the words of the matchmaker. Qin Keqing was originally worried that she would meet a rude and stupid man who would humiliate her.
But seeing the young man's majestic appearance, like a orchid and jade tree, with a calm demeanor, a trace of worry gradually disappeared from his heart.
